record.title: Implement and qualify the recovered factory point-command sender
record.intent: Prepare one isolated factory-protocol compatibility trial with retained framing and evidence controls.
requirements: Add a distinct typed factory point command and explicit CLI entry points without changing the earlier HawkRAO frame semantics. Use whole MHz plus hundredths, raw power codes zero through three, and CR LF framing.

Reject unrepresentable frequencies and payload bytes that conflict with the recovered CR delimiter. Revalidate unchecked model copies before opening a port. Reuse the bounded one-write transport and durable evidence delegate with explicit protocol provenance.

Verify independent frame vectors, fractional units, invalid fields, host PTY delivery, evidence seals and uncertain outcomes. Run workspace checks and installed-wheel controls without opening any physical endpoint.
Record the operator-selected one-power-cycle preparation as a deliberate replacement for the prior decision's serial cleanup proposal. No physical operation occurs in this preparation task.
acceptance: The separate factory encoder and evidence path pass host controls and are committed and pushed before physical execution.
